<script id="mng-ad-free-7day-js-after">
	( function () {
		const config = window.mngAdFree7DayConfig;
		if ( ! config ) {
			return;
		}

		function currentUserId() {
			const parts = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split( ';' ) : [];
			for ( let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++ ) {
				const pair = parts[ i ].split( '=' );
				if ( pair[ 0 ].trim() === config.userCookie ) {
					try {
						return decodeURIComponent( pair.slice( 1 ).join( '=' ) );
					} catch ( e ) {
						return '';
					}
				}
			}
			return '';
		}

		function decodeJwtPayload( token ) {
			try {
				const segment = token.split( '.' )[ 1 ];
				if ( ! segment ) {
					return null;
				}
				let b64 = segment.replace( /-/g, '+' ).replace( /_/g, '/' );
				while ( b64.length % 4 ) {
					b64 += '=';
				}
				return JSON.parse( atob( b64 ) );
			} catch ( e ) {
				return null;
			}
		}

		function entitlementClaims() {
			try {
				const session = JSON.parse(
					window.localStorage.getItem( config.sessionKey ) || '{}'
				);
				return ( session.entitlementToken &&
					decodeJwtPayload( session.entitlementToken ) ) || {};
			} catch ( e ) {
				return {};
			}
		}

		function clearCachedEnabled() {
			try {
				window.localStorage.removeItem( config.cacheKey );
			} catch ( e ) {}
		}

		// Bound to the reader it was resolved for, so it cannot outlive a
		// logout or leak on a shared device. Positive results expire after TTL.
		function readCachedEnabled() {
			try {
				const raw = window.localStorage.getItem( config.cacheKey );
				if ( ! raw ) {
					return false;
				}
				const cached = JSON.parse( raw );
				const userId = currentUserId();
				if (
					! userId ||
					cached.userId !== userId ||
					cached.enabled !== true ||
					! cached.expiresAt ||
					Date.now() > cached.expiresAt
				) {
					clearCachedEnabled();
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			} catch ( e ) {
				clearCachedEnabled();
				return false;
			}
		}

		function writeCachedEnabled( enabled ) {
			if ( ! enabled ) {
				clearCachedEnabled();
				return;
			}
			try {
				const userId = currentUserId();
				if ( ! userId ) {
					clearCachedEnabled();
					return;
				}
				window.localStorage.setItem( config.cacheKey, JSON.stringify( {
					userId: userId,
					enabled: true,
					expiresAt: Date.now() + config.cacheTtlMs
				} ) );
			} catch ( e ) {}
		}

		function ensureLogoutClear() {
			window.MNGAuthentication = window.MNGAuthentication || {};
			const callbacks = window.MNGAuthentication.logoutCallbacks;
			if (
				Array.isArray( callbacks ) &&
				callbacks.indexOf( clearCachedEnabled ) === -1
			) {
				callbacks.push( clearCachedEnabled );
			}
		}

		window.MNGAuthentication = window.MNGAuthentication || {};

		let originalIsUserAdFree = window.MNGAuthentication.isUserAdFree;

		// Existing ad-free users (premium, employees, ad-free templates)
		// must stay ad-free even if they are not in this experiment.
		function underlyingSaysAdFree() {
			if ( originalIsUserAdFree === true ) {
				return true;
			}
			if ( typeof originalIsUserAdFree === 'function' ) {
				return !! originalIsUserAdFree.call( window.MNGAuthentication );
			}
			return false;
		}

		function isUserAdFree() {
			return underlyingSaysAdFree() || readCachedEnabled();
		}

		// entitlements.js may assign isUserAdFree before or after this runs.
		Object.defineProperty( window.MNGAuthentication, 'isUserAdFree', {
			configurable: true,
			get: function () {
				return isUserAdFree;
			},
			set: function ( value ) {
				originalIsUserAdFree = value;
			}
		} );

		// Context is passed per evaluation, so this only waits on the
		// datafile. Still resolves after this page's ad scripts have run,
		// so the arm applies from the next page view.
		function resolve() {
			ensureLogoutClear();
			const visor = window.mngfeatures && window.mngfeatures.visor;
			if ( ! visor ) {
				return;
			}
			const userId = currentUserId();
			const claims = entitlementClaims();
			if ( ! userId || ! claims.entitlement_level ) {
				return;
			}
			const level = String( claims.entitlement_level ).trim().toLowerCase();
			const service = String( claims.entitlement_serviceCode || 'unknown' ).trim();

			const enabled = visor.isEnabled( config.flagId, {
				userId: userId,
				subscriptionLevel: level + '-' + service
			} );
			writeCachedEnabled( enabled );
		}

		ensureLogoutClear();

		// Whichever fires first: the session may land before the datafile
		// or after it.
		if ( window.mngfeatures && window.mngfeatures.visor ) {
			resolve();
		}
		window.addEventListener( 'mng-feature-flags-init', resolve );
		window.addEventListener( 'mng-feature-flags-ready', resolve );
	} )();
//# sourceURL=mng-ad-free-7day-js-after
</script>

			var poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				if (window.engageLibrary && typeof window.engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter === 'function') {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve();
				} else if (Date.now() - started > readyTimeoutMs) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					reject(new Error('engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter not available'));
				}
			}, 100);
		});
	}

	function subscribeRegwallNewsletter() {
		var prefId = window.authentication_config && window.authentication_config.regwallPrefId;
		if (!prefId) {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'no regwallPrefId, skipping newsletter subscribe');
			return Promise.resolve(false);
		}
		var email = getAuthEmail();
		if (!email) {
			console.warn(logPrefix, 'no auth email, skipping newsletter subscribe');
			return Promise.resolve(false);
		}
		return waitForEngageSubscribe().then(function () {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'subscribing', email, 'to prefId', prefId);
			return window.engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter(email, Number(prefId));
		});
	}

	function waitForAuthEmail() {
		return new Promise(function (resolve) {
			var email = getAuthEmail();
			if (email) {
				resolve(email);
				return;
			}
			var started = Date.now();
			var poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				var nextEmail = getAuthEmail();
				if (nextEmail) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve(nextEmail);
				} else if (Date.now() - started > readyTimeoutMs) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve('');
				}
			}, 50);
		});
	}

	function urlWithoutWallOverride() {
		var url = new URL(window.location.href);
		if (!url.searchParams.has('wall_override')) {
			return '';
		}
		url.searchParams.delete('wall_override');
		return url.pathname + url.search + url.hash;
	}

	function dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar() {
		var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
		if (!cleanPath) {
			return false;
		}
		window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.origin + cleanPath);
		console.info(logPrefix, 'removed wall_override from the URL before embed login reload');
		return true;
	}

	(function patchLocationReload() {
		try {
			var originalReload = window.location.reload.bind(window.location);
			window.location.reload = function () {
				if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
					var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
					if (cleanPath) {
						console.info(logPrefix, 'embed login reload: dropping wall_override');
						window.location.replace(window.location.origin + cleanPath);
						return;
					}
				}
				return originalReload();
			};
		} catch (e) {}
	})();

	var finishingSocialLogin = false;

	function finishRegwallSocialLogin() {
		if (finishingSocialLogin) {
			return;
		}
		finishingSocialLogin = true;
		hideSocialLogin();

		waitForAuthEmail().then(function () {
			if (sessionStorage.getItem(newsletterDoneFlag) === '1') {
				return false;
			}
			return subscribeRegwallNewsletter().then(function (ok) {
				sessionStorage.setItem(newsletterDoneFlag, '1');
				console.info(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe', ok ? 'succeeded' : 'skipped or failed');
				return ok;
			});
		}).catch(function (err) {
			console.error(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe error', err);
		}).then(function () {
			if (!isEntitledSubscriber()) {
				grantRegwallAccessCookies();
			}
			return waitForNativeSession();
		}).then(function (hasSession) {
			if (!hasSession) {
				console.warn(logPrefix, 'embed login did not persist __MNG_Session');
			}
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			sessionStorage.removeItem(pendingFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(reloadedFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(newsletterDoneFlag);
			finishingSocialLogin = false;
		});
	}

	function onAuthenticated() {
		hideSocialLogin();
		if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			finishRegwallSocialLogin();
		}
	}

	function getAuthScriptEl() {
		return document.querySelector('script[src*="mng-auth"]');
	}

	function getAuthScriptSrc() {
		var el = getAuthScriptEl();
		return el ? el.src : '(no mng-auth script tag)';
	}

	function authDiagnostics() {
		return [
			'script=' + getAuthScriptSrc(),
			'MNGAuth=' + typeof window.MNGAuth,
			'module=' + typeof window.module,
			'exports=' + typeof window.exports,
			'define=' + typeof window.define,
			'define.amd=' + !!(window.define && window.define.amd)
		].join(' ');
	}

	function adoptMngAuth() {
		if (window.MNGAuth && (typeof window.MNGAuth.init === 'function' || typeof window.MNGAuth.showScreen === 'function')) {
			return window.MNGAuth;
		}
		var candidates = [];
		if (window.module && window.module.exports) {
			candidates.push(window.module.exports.MNGAuth || window.module.exports);
		}
		if (window.exports) {
			candidates.push(window.exports.MNGAuth || window.exports);
		}
		for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
			var candidate = candidates[i];
			if (candidate && (typeof candidate.init === 'function' || typeof candidate.showScreen === 'function')) {
				window.MNGAuth = candidate;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'adopted MNGAuth from UMD export');
				return candidate;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	function waitForMngAuth() {
		if (window.__mngAuthReadyPromise) {
			return window.__mngAuthReadyPromise;
		}
		window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (adoptMngAuth()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			var settled = false;

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				resolve();
			}

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = null;
				reject(new Error(message + ' ' + authDiagnostics()));
			}

			function shadowUmdGlobals() {
				var saved = {
					module: window.module,
					exports: window.exports,
					define: window.define
				};
				try {
					delete window.module;
					delete window.exports;
					delete window.define;
				} catch (e) {
					window.module = undefined;
					window.exports = undefined;
					window.define = undefined;
				}
				return saved;
			}

			function restoreUmdGlobals(saved) {
				try {
					if (typeof saved.module !== 'undefined') {
						window.module = saved.module;
					}
					if (typeof saved.exports !== 'undefined') {
						window.exports = saved.exports;
					}
					if (typeof saved.define !== 'undefined') {
						window.define = saved.define;
					}
				} catch (e) {}
			}

			function loadIsolatedCopy() {
				var src = getAuthScriptSrc();
				if (src === '(no mng-auth script tag)') {
					fail('mng-auth.js is not on the page');
					return;
				}
				console.info(logPrefix, 'reloading mng-auth.js without UMD globals');
				var saved = shadowUmdGlobals();
				var script = document.createElement('script');
				script.src = src;
				script.onload = function () {
					restoreUmdGlobals(saved);
					if (adoptMngAuth()) {
						succeed();
						return;
					}
					fail('CDN loaded but did not expose window.MNGAuth');
				};
				script.onerror = function () {
					restoreUmdGlobals(saved);
					fail('mng-auth.js failed to load');
				};
				document.head.appendChild(script);
			}

			var existing = getAuthScriptEl();
			if (existing && document.readyState === 'loading') {
				existing.addEventListener('load', function () {
					if (adoptMngAuth()) {
						succeed();
						return;
					}
					loadIsolatedCopy();
				});
				existing.addEventListener('error', function () {
					fail('existing mng-auth.js tag failed to load');
				});
				return;
			}

			loadIsolatedCopy();
		});
		return window.__mngAuthReadyPromise;
	}

	function waitForEmbedReady() {
		return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (isEmbedReady()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			var settled = false;
			var poll;

			function cleanup() {
				window.clearInterval(poll);
				document.removeEventListener('mng.auth.onFinished', onFinished);
			}

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				resolve();
			}

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new Error(message));
			}

			function onFinished() {
				if (isEmbedReady()) {
					succeed();
					return;
				}
				fail('mng-auth reported onFinished but #mng-modal was not created. script=' + getAuthScriptSrc());
			}

			document.addEventListener('mng.auth.onFinished', onFinished);
			poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				if (isEmbedReady()) {
					succeed();
				}
			}, 100);
			window.setTimeout(function () {
				fail('timed out waiting for #mng-modal. script=' + getAuthScriptSrc());
			}, readyTimeoutMs);
		});
	}

	function openEmbedLogin(button) {
		var connection = button.getAttribute('data-mng-auth-social-action');
		console.info(logPrefix, 'click', button.getAttribute('data-mng-cta'), '- waiting for embed login', connection, getAuthScriptSrc());
		return waitForMngAuth().then(function () {
			if (isEmbedReady()) {
				button.__mngSocialForward = true;
				button.click();
				button.__mngSocialForward = false;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'forwarded social click to embed login', connection);
				return;
			}
			return waitForEmbedReady().then(function () {
				button.__mngSocialForward = true;
				button.click();
				button.__mngSocialForward = false;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'forwarded social click to embed login', connection);
			});
		}).catch(function (err) {
			console.error(logPrefix, 'failed to open embed login', err);
		});
	}

	document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
		var button = event.target.closest('.digisubs-social-login__button');
		if (!button || button.__mngSocialForward) {
			return;
		}
		sessionStorage.setItem(pendingFlag, '1');
		if (isEmbedReady() && window.MNGAuth) {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'click', button.getAttribute('data-mng-cta'), '- letting embed login handle', button.getAttribute('data-mng-auth-social-action'));
			return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		event.stopPropagation();
		openEmbedLogin(button);
	});

	['authenticationReady', 'mng-auth-check-complete', 'entitlementsReady'].forEach(function (name) {
		window.addEventListener(name, function () {
			if (isAuthenticated()) {
				onAuthenticated();
			}
		}, true);
	});
	['mng.auth.onReady', 'mng.auth.onLogin', 'mng.auth.onAuthDetermined', 'mng.auth.onEntitlementsDetermined'].forEach(function (name) {
		document.addEventListener(name, function () {
			if (isAuthenticated()) {
				onAuthenticated();
			}
		}, true);
	});

	if (window.authentication_config && window.authentication_config.debug === '1') {
		console.info(logPrefix, 'bridge ready', typeof window.MNGAuth, getAuthScriptSrc());
	}

	if (isAuthenticated()) {
		onAuthenticated();
	}
})();

			var poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				if (window.engageLibrary && typeof window.engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter === 'function') {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve();
				} else if (Date.now() - started > readyTimeoutMs) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					reject(new Error('engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter not available'));
				}
			}, 100);
		});
	}

	function subscribeRegwallNewsletter() {
		var prefId = window.authentication_config && window.authentication_config.regwallPrefId;
		if (!prefId) {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'no regwallPrefId, skipping newsletter subscribe');
			return Promise.resolve(false);
		}
		var email = getAuthEmail();
		if (!email) {
			console.warn(logPrefix, 'no auth email, skipping newsletter subscribe');
			return Promise.resolve(false);
		}
		return waitForEngageSubscribe().then(function () {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'subscribing', email, 'to prefId', prefId);
			return window.engageLibrary.sspwSuscribeToNewsletter(email, Number(prefId));
		});
	}

	function waitForAuthEmail() {
		return new Promise(function (resolve) {
			var email = getAuthEmail();
			if (email) {
				resolve(email);
				return;
			}
			var started = Date.now();
			var poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				var nextEmail = getAuthEmail();
				if (nextEmail) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve(nextEmail);
				} else if (Date.now() - started > readyTimeoutMs) {
					window.clearInterval(poll);
					resolve('');
				}
			}, 50);
		});
	}

	function urlWithoutWallOverride() {
		var url = new URL(window.location.href);
		if (!url.searchParams.has('wall_override')) {
			return '';
		}
		url.searchParams.delete('wall_override');
		return url.pathname + url.search + url.hash;
	}

	function dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar() {
		var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
		if (!cleanPath) {
			return false;
		}
		window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.origin + cleanPath);
		console.info(logPrefix, 'removed wall_override from the URL before embed login reload');
		return true;
	}

	(function patchLocationReload() {
		try {
			var originalReload = window.location.reload.bind(window.location);
			window.location.reload = function () {
				if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
					var cleanPath = urlWithoutWallOverride();
					if (cleanPath) {
						console.info(logPrefix, 'embed login reload: dropping wall_override');
						window.location.replace(window.location.origin + cleanPath);
						return;
					}
				}
				return originalReload();
			};
		} catch (e) {}
	})();

	var finishingSocialLogin = false;

	function finishRegwallSocialLogin() {
		if (finishingSocialLogin) {
			return;
		}
		finishingSocialLogin = true;
		hideSocialLogin();

		waitForAuthEmail().then(function () {
			if (sessionStorage.getItem(newsletterDoneFlag) === '1') {
				return false;
			}
			return subscribeRegwallNewsletter().then(function (ok) {
				sessionStorage.setItem(newsletterDoneFlag, '1');
				console.info(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe', ok ? 'succeeded' : 'skipped or failed');
				return ok;
			});
		}).catch(function (err) {
			console.error(logPrefix, 'newsletter subscribe error', err);
		}).then(function () {
			if (!isEntitledSubscriber()) {
				grantRegwallAccessCookies();
			}
			return waitForNativeSession();
		}).then(function (hasSession) {
			if (!hasSession) {
				console.warn(logPrefix, 'embed login did not persist __MNG_Session');
			}
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			sessionStorage.removeItem(pendingFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(reloadedFlag);
			sessionStorage.removeItem(newsletterDoneFlag);
			finishingSocialLogin = false;
		});
	}

	function onAuthenticated() {
		hideSocialLogin();
		if (sessionStorage.getItem(pendingFlag) === '1') {
			dropWallOverrideFromAddressBar();
			finishRegwallSocialLogin();
		}
	}

	function getAuthScriptEl() {
		return document.querySelector('script[src*="mng-auth"]');
	}

	function getAuthScriptSrc() {
		var el = getAuthScriptEl();
		return el ? el.src : '(no mng-auth script tag)';
	}

	function authDiagnostics() {
		return [
			'script=' + getAuthScriptSrc(),
			'MNGAuth=' + typeof window.MNGAuth,
			'module=' + typeof window.module,
			'exports=' + typeof window.exports,
			'define=' + typeof window.define,
			'define.amd=' + !!(window.define && window.define.amd)
		].join(' ');
	}

	function adoptMngAuth() {
		if (window.MNGAuth && (typeof window.MNGAuth.init === 'function' || typeof window.MNGAuth.showScreen === 'function')) {
			return window.MNGAuth;
		}
		var candidates = [];
		if (window.module && window.module.exports) {
			candidates.push(window.module.exports.MNGAuth || window.module.exports);
		}
		if (window.exports) {
			candidates.push(window.exports.MNGAuth || window.exports);
		}
		for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
			var candidate = candidates[i];
			if (candidate && (typeof candidate.init === 'function' || typeof candidate.showScreen === 'function')) {
				window.MNGAuth = candidate;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'adopted MNGAuth from UMD export');
				return candidate;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	function waitForMngAuth() {
		if (window.__mngAuthReadyPromise) {
			return window.__mngAuthReadyPromise;
		}
		window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (adoptMngAuth()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			var settled = false;

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				resolve();
			}

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				window.__mngAuthReadyPromise = null;
				reject(new Error(message + ' ' + authDiagnostics()));
			}

			function shadowUmdGlobals() {
				var saved = {
					module: window.module,
					exports: window.exports,
					define: window.define
				};
				try {
					delete window.module;
					delete window.exports;
					delete window.define;
				} catch (e) {
					window.module = undefined;
					window.exports = undefined;
					window.define = undefined;
				}
				return saved;
			}

			function restoreUmdGlobals(saved) {
				try {
					if (typeof saved.module !== 'undefined') {
						window.module = saved.module;
					}
					if (typeof saved.exports !== 'undefined') {
						window.exports = saved.exports;
					}
					if (typeof saved.define !== 'undefined') {
						window.define = saved.define;
					}
				} catch (e) {}
			}

			function loadIsolatedCopy() {
				var src = getAuthScriptSrc();
				if (src === '(no mng-auth script tag)') {
					fail('mng-auth.js is not on the page');
					return;
				}
				console.info(logPrefix, 'reloading mng-auth.js without UMD globals');
				var saved = shadowUmdGlobals();
				var script = document.createElement('script');
				script.src = src;
				script.onload = function () {
					restoreUmdGlobals(saved);
					if (adoptMngAuth()) {
						succeed();
						return;
					}
					fail('CDN loaded but did not expose window.MNGAuth');
				};
				script.onerror = function () {
					restoreUmdGlobals(saved);
					fail('mng-auth.js failed to load');
				};
				document.head.appendChild(script);
			}

			var existing = getAuthScriptEl();
			if (existing && document.readyState === 'loading') {
				existing.addEventListener('load', function () {
					if (adoptMngAuth()) {
						succeed();
						return;
					}
					loadIsolatedCopy();
				});
				existing.addEventListener('error', function () {
					fail('existing mng-auth.js tag failed to load');
				});
				return;
			}

			loadIsolatedCopy();
		});
		return window.__mngAuthReadyPromise;
	}

	function waitForEmbedReady() {
		return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			if (isEmbedReady()) {
				resolve();
				return;
			}

			var settled = false;
			var poll;

			function cleanup() {
				window.clearInterval(poll);
				document.removeEventListener('mng.auth.onFinished', onFinished);
			}

			function succeed() {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				resolve();
			}

			function fail(message) {
				if (settled) {
					return;
				}
				settled = true;
				cleanup();
				reject(new Error(message));
			}

			function onFinished() {
				if (isEmbedReady()) {
					succeed();
					return;
				}
				fail('mng-auth reported onFinished but #mng-modal was not created. script=' + getAuthScriptSrc());
			}

			document.addEventListener('mng.auth.onFinished', onFinished);
			poll = window.setInterval(function () {
				if (isEmbedReady()) {
					succeed();
				}
			}, 100);
			window.setTimeout(function () {
				fail('timed out waiting for #mng-modal. script=' + getAuthScriptSrc());
			}, readyTimeoutMs);
		});
	}

	function openEmbedLogin(button) {
		var connection = button.getAttribute('data-mng-auth-social-action');
		console.info(logPrefix, 'click', button.getAttribute('data-mng-cta'), '- waiting for embed login', connection, getAuthScriptSrc());
		return waitForMngAuth().then(function () {
			if (isEmbedReady()) {
				button.__mngSocialForward = true;
				button.click();
				button.__mngSocialForward = false;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'forwarded social click to embed login', connection);
				return;
			}
			return waitForEmbedReady().then(function () {
				button.__mngSocialForward = true;
				button.click();
				button.__mngSocialForward = false;
				console.info(logPrefix, 'forwarded social click to embed login', connection);
			});
		}).catch(function (err) {
			console.error(logPrefix, 'failed to open embed login', err);
		});
	}

	document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
		var button = event.target.closest('.digisubs-social-login__button');
		if (!button || button.__mngSocialForward) {
			return;
		}
		sessionStorage.setItem(pendingFlag, '1');
		if (isEmbedReady() && window.MNGAuth) {
			console.info(logPrefix, 'click', button.getAttribute('data-mng-cta'), '- letting embed login handle', button.getAttribute('data-mng-auth-social-action'));
			return;
		}
		event.preventDefault();
		event.stopPropagation();
		openEmbedLogin(button);
	});

	['authenticationReady', 'mng-auth-check-complete', 'entitlementsReady'].forEach(function (name) {
		window.addEventListener(name, function () {
			if (isAuthenticated()) {
				onAuthenticated();
			}
		}, true);
	});
	['mng.auth.onReady', 'mng.auth.onLogin', 'mng.auth.onAuthDetermined', 'mng.auth.onEntitlementsDetermined'].forEach(function (name) {
		document.addEventListener(name, function () {
			if (isAuthenticated()) {
				onAuthenticated();
			}
		}, true);
	});

	if (window.authentication_config && window.authentication_config.debug === '1') {
		console.info(logPrefix, 'bridge ready', typeof window.MNGAuth, getAuthScriptSrc());
	}

	if (isAuthenticated()) {
		onAuthenticated();
	}
})();
